description: Ask Kayla, Knobs.co's Trade Manager (twenty years in cabinet hardware), to review the shopper's plan by email within one business day, or to set up a call. Only with the shopper's email and their clear agreement to be contacted. This sends the shopper ONE email with a confirmation link; Kayla receives the request only after they click it (within 7 days), so tell the shopper to look for an email from cs@knobs.co and confirm. Include the plan_url from build_plan when there is one, and say in message what they want Kayla to do.

email.description: the shopper's email, given by them for this purpose

kind.description: review = Kayla reviews the plan and emails back; call = Kayla sets up a call (the confirmation page opens her calendar)

message.description: what the shopper wants from Kayla, in their words, plus anything she needs to know (no links)

name.description: the shopper's name as they gave it (first name is enough)

phone.description: phone number, only if the shopper offered it (useful when kind is "call")

plan_url.description: the plan_url from build_plan, when there is a plan

name: request_consultation
title: Ask Kayla to review or call (Knobs.co)
